Look up property validators

Source: R/basevalidators.R
get_validator.Rd

For packages building on plotly.core (such as plotly): get_validator() returns the validator of a property, by its dotted path in the plotly.js schema (e.g. "scatter.marker.symbol", "layout.xaxis"), or NULL if there is none. Compound validators list their properties in children; trace validators have a trace_type. available_trace_types() lists the trace types.

Usage

get_validator(key)

available_trace_types()

Arguments

key

A dotted property path.

Value

A validator (a list), or NULL; or a character vector.
